Container.Name: dawarich_db

Branch.TagDescription: PostGIS 17-3.5 in a light weight Alpine Linux container

Container.Overview:
PostGIS database container for Dawarich. PostGIS is a spatial database extender for PostgreSQL object-relational database. The postgis/postgis image provides tags for running Postgres with PostGIS extensions installed.
Dawarich is a self-hosted web app designed to replace Google Timeline (aka Google Location History). Visualize your data on an interactive map, import your location history from Google Maps Timeline and Owntracks, and explore statistics like the number of countries and cities visited, total distance traveled, and more!
NOTE: Do not use autoupdate and do not update any Dawarich container without backing up your data first and checking for breaking changes in the updating guides. https://dawarich.app/docs/self-hosting/updating/ https://dawarich.app/docs/self-hosting/maintenance/backup-and-restore/

Container.Requires: For Dawarich production 3 docker containers are required: - dawarich_app - web app including sidekiq worker for background jobs - dawarich_db - PostGIS database - dawarich_redis - Redis database

Config.Name: Data directory
Config.Description: Persistent PostgreSQL database directory. Stores Dawarich's database and must be preserved across container updates.

Config.Name: Database username
Config.Description: PostgreSQL username. Must match DATABASE_USERNAME in the Dawarich app container.

Config.Name: Database password
Config.Description: PostgreSQL password. Must match DATABASE_PASSWORD in the Dawarich app container.

Config.Name: Database name
Config.Description: PostgreSQL database name. Must match DATABASE_NAME in the Dawarich app container. Using 'dawarich_development' from a pre-production build is supported with dawarich_app running in production mode.

Config.Name: Database port
Config.Description: Optional host port for external PostgreSQL access. Containers on the same Docker network connect using port 5432.
